text:
anna_devex: Published py/ts SDK canary (0.9.0-canary). Tagging + docs sync kicked off. Quick checklist: pin internal manifests to previous stable, add deprecation note for sync client, watch for regressions 60m. @sam_release can you confirm npm/pypi propagation?

deploy-bot: Release job finished: py-sdk@0.9.0-canary pushed to npm and pypi. Artifacts: ci-artifacts/1876543210. Links: https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/sdk/v/0.9.0-canary, https://pypi.org/project/redwood-sdk/0.9.0-canary

sam_release: Saw it — npm propagated to registry, pypi index updated but CDN might lag ~10m. I'll open a quick PR to pin internal manifests to 0.8.7 and add a note in release-notes.md about canary. Suggested pin command for infra: `sed -i 's/"@redwood\/sdk": ".*"/"@redwood\/sdk": "0.8.7"/' infra/manifests/*.json`

chris_eng: FYI staging tests failing for TS client after canary — gateway returning 429s on batched publish flow. Logs: `gateway: request size 65412 -> 413 Payload Too Large` (looks like new default batching header growth)

anna_devex: Ugh. thanks @chris_eng. For safety, please pin manifests to 0.8.7 (sam's PR) and hold any automated promotion. @deploy-bot set hold on py-ts-publish for 1h. Also add rollback note to the canary release entry.

deploy-bot: Hold added by anna_devex on job `py-ts-publish` for 60m. Next automated promote blocked.

maria_docs: I'll draft release notes and migration snippet. Proposed short deprecation blurb: "Sync client (sync blocking API) is deprecated in favor of async/await clients — see migration snippet under Breaking Changes." Will add example conversion for the publish flow.

chris_eng: Root cause narrowed: TS client increased default batch window, which made single payloads exceed gateway limit when attachments present. Patch ready (restore prior batching defaults). Built a patched canary at 0.9.1-canary (artifact 1876543300).

anna_devex: Ok plan: unpublish 0.9.0-canary from npm (can't truly remove from pypi) and publish 0.9.1-canary with patch. For npm: `npm unpublish @redwood/sdk@0.9.0-canary` then `npm publish --tag canary`. For pypi, publish new sdist/wheels 0.9.1-canary and mark 0.9.0-canary as yanked in release notes. @sam_release take the lead.

sam_release: Working on artifacts now. Creating 0.9.1-canary and updating manifests. Adding rollback/incident note to release-notes.md and CHANGELOG-canary.md. Will also include a short note to engineering: "If you pinned 0.8.7, leave it until we green staging and confirm gateway tolerances."

deploy-bot: Draft release note entry for 0.9.1-canary created: https://internal/release-notes/1876543210.

anna_devex: :thumbsup: After patched canary is out, let's monitor for 60m. If no regressions, promote to RC with staged rollout. maria_docs please include migration snippet and a short deprecation line (one-liner + link to full guide). Closing watch in 90m unless issues.

chris_eng: Sounds good. I'll rerun staging tests on patched canary and ping here with quick pass/fail.

maria_docs: Will push docs PR once sam confirms published artifacts. Planning to add a small code block showing `await client.publish(...)` conversion and a note about batch size config.

anna_devex: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open for updates — add short replies only to avoid noise.
